description: MANAGEMENT data class. Discover budget ids and versions without identity fields. Locked FX rate and all money-valued fields are decimal strings. Filter status or fiscal-year start before paging. The signed page_token is pinned to the complete filtered source; restart at page 1 if source_changed. This lists budget headers only, not cells, approvals identities, or a recalculated budget.

page_token.description: Signed continuation from the prior page; restart without it if source_changed.
